clips.title: The story
paras: In the Deadmines, brilliant Edwin VanCleef commands the Defias Brotherhood. He once led the Stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind City after the Second War. The House of Nobles denied the workers their promised pay, and VanCleef now seeks vengeance against the kingdom he helped restore.

Edwin VanCleef led the Stonemasons Guild as it rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War. A peerless craftsman and idealist, he mastered architecture and directed the building of the capital's grand ramparts and towering cathedrals. His childhood friend Mathias Shaw trained him in stealth, subterfuge, and bladecraft, making VanCleef a deadly operative as well as a master architect.

After years of labor, the Stonemasons finished rebuilding Stormwind. The House of Nobles had run up colossal debts through military campaigns and refused the guild its promised compensation. VanCleef demanded restitution, but the nobles dissolved the guild. He led the workers in a riot and out of the city. In the chaos, his lieutenant and most trusted assistant, Bazil Thredd, was captured and left in the Stockade. In Westfall, VanCleef gathered the exiled workers and allied outcasts under the Defias Brotherhood's banner.
